description:
You are one of several procurement officers at a hospital network choosing a vendor for a new patient-records system. Each officer has reviewed different parts of the bids and reference checks.

The options are:
- Vendor A (Motirke Fenbrene)
- Vendor B (Quoheskith Lunolfen)
- Vendor C (Quovokquo Quonoltal)
- Vendor D (Quobreoz Fengarva)

Exactly one option is best overall. Which vendor should be selected? Your notes are incomplete: other participants hold information you do not have.

Vendor A (Motirke Fenbrene):
  - Vendor A is fully compliant with health-data regulations
  - Vendor A passed an independent security audit
  - Vendor A is financially stable
  - Vendor A charges extra for data migration
  - Vendor A reported 8 major outages last year
Vendor B (Quoheskith Lunolfen):
  - Vendor B performs encrypted off-site backups
  - Vendor B provides no staff training
  - Vendor B estimates deployment will take 11 months
Vendor C (Quovokquo Quonoltal):
  - Vendor C guarantees 99.9% uptime in its contract
  - Vendor C includes free data migration
  - Vendor C uses a proprietary format only
  - Vendor C has unresolved compliance findings
  - Vendor C quoted a total cost of 613 thousand per year
